newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Banamex-Accival lowers Bimbo to neutral.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Banamex-Accival lowers Bimbo to neutral.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Banamex-Accival said it had lowered bread and pastry maker Grupo Industrial Bimbo to neutral from buy.
The brokerage did not give an official reason for the downgrade, but an Accival analyst who asked to remain anonymous said it was because Bimbo was not expected to outperform the market.
"The current stock price is 55 pesos and the price objective for the year-end is 62 pesos, which really represents growth in line with the general market," the analyst said.
Bimbo's A shares stood at 55 pesos in late morning trade, up from 54.90 at Monday's close.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City Newsroom 525 728 7912))
